items.statement: The investigation retains distinct reactant-complex and H-transfer saddle candidates and validates the selected stationary points by frequency analysis and atom-conserving connectivity evidence.
items.expected: Candidate identity is retained; the selected minimum has no imaginary frequency, the selected TS has one H-transfer imaginary mode, and connectivity evidence links the reactant and product sides.

items.statement: The validated elementary event is hydrogen transfer from methane to bisulfate radical, yielding a methyl-radical/product-side state.
items.expected: The submitted atom mapping and mode assignment show H transfer from CH4 to HSO4• and formation of CH3• plus sulfuric-acid-side product chemistry.

items.statement: The solution-phase Gibbs barrier for the HSO4• + methane HAT step is approximately 11 kcal/mol at the paper's refined reference level.
items.expected: A submitted barrier near 11.4 kcal/mol, reported in kcal/mol and tied to the validated selected candidate and reactant reference state.
